item.text:
[
  {"task_id":"obj-p7-1","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,9],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Colour-and-holes pairs distinguish the hole-free colour-2 objects, which become 6 in demonstrations 2 and 3, from colour-1 and colour-3 objects, which retain their colours."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p4-3","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,9,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Size rank selects the recolouring: demonstration 1 changes ranks 1 and 3 to 6 and rank 4 to 7; demonstrations 2 and 3 change rank 1 to 6."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p5-0","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,0,9,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"The largest objects, of sizes 9, 5, and 6 respectively, become 9; every smaller object becomes 8."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p3-1","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,9,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Width-1 objects become 9, the width-2 L in demonstration 2 becomes 5, and width-3 rectangles and rings become 6."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p1-0","params":{"prop":[0,9,0,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"All hole-free objects become 7; the one-hole ring in demonstration 2 becomes 5."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p3-0","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,9,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Widths 1, 2, and 3 become 7, 9, and 8 respectively, including the vertical line, square, and cross in demonstration 3."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p5-3","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,0,9,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Smallest objects become 9, including both tied size-3 objects in demonstration 2; largest and other objects become 8."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p1-3","params":{"prop":[0,9,0,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Every demonstrated object has zero holes and becomes 5, across single pixels, lines, squares, L shapes, and crosses."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p5-2","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,0,9,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"The largest object becomes 6 in each demonstration; all smallest and intermediate objects become 8."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p0-0","params":{"prop":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Pixel counts 2, 3, and 6 become 7, 8, and 9 respectively; size-4 squares and the size-9 square retain their colours."}
]
